verdict.rationale: The Comptroller's open-data page says it publishes machine-readable, platform-independent raw datasets on revenue, expenditures, procurement, taxes and fees. A hands-on probe confirmed that its Active Franchise Tax Permit Holders registry dataset answers a keyless Socrata SODA query with structured JSON rows, so no scraping is needed. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of full-file bulk export formats, dataset catalog breadth, and refresh cadence.
